title: Product Release Roundup: October 2025 | Great Question
summary: New to Great Question in October: AI moderated interviews, role-based access, democratized pricing & more.
body_markdown:
You say it better than we do. **Customers always do.**


That's why I'm not even going to try to top what Nico, VP of Product and Design at Brex, said:


*“Research isn’t something that happens in a silo anymore. It’s everyone’s responsibility, and Great Question made that possible.”*


This is our life's work. And today, we're taking it to another level with **AI moderated interviews** , **more governance** , and **new pricing** that supports our vision to democratize research.


## **🗣️ Get interview depth at survey scale with AI moderated interviews**


Not just another chatbot. This is research-grade AI that adapts in real time. Define your objectives, topics to cover and our AI moderator interviews hundreds of participants across time zones. It probes for detail, captures nuance, and delivers the depth you'd normally only get from live moderation. Every transcript, highlight reel, and insight is automatically stored in your repository.


[Book a demo to see it in action →](https://greatquestion.co/about/demo)


## **🚀 Pricing designed for research democratization**


Asana went from a handful of researchers to company-wide participation. Brex put customer conversations in the hands of PMs, designers, and engineers. ServiceNow runs 300+ studies a year, connecting with over 10,000 end users across research, design, and product teams.


This is what happens when research evolves from something handled by a few to something embedded across the company, with the right guardrails in place. Our new democratized pricing supports that: helping your team scale research responsibly, without trading rigor for access.


**Want to learn how our new democratized pricing helps you scale research across your org?**


[Book a call to learn more →](https://greatquestion.co/about/demo)


## **🔐 Set permissions by role for secure, scalable collaboration**


You asked for more granular access for different team members, and we listened.
We've started a gradual rollout so admins can now set permissions by role across your workspace. Control who can add or export candidates, create study types, enable livestreams, and manage external recruitment.


Enterprise-grade control that doesn't slow teams down. Available on Enterprise plans. Want the full rundown?


[Book an Enterprise demo →](https://greatquestion.co/about/demo)


## **🙋 Get the right participants automatically with smarter screeners**


Smarter screeners are here to win back time in your day. Set qualification rules and let automation handle the rest. Qualified participants move forward without manual review, while others are automatically screened out to a customizable disqualification page. All while maintaining full visibility into who qualifies and why.[Step-by-step guide here.](https://greatquestion.co/support/modular-study-add-ons/screeners-ea)


[Create a study with a screener →](https://greatquestion.co/studies/new)


## **📁 Keep all research context in one place: PDF support now GA**


PDF support is ready for you to try. Upload research reports, documentation, and reference materials directly to your repository. View, tag, search, and keep all your research context in one place.


[Add your first PDF →](https://greatquestion.co/repository/insights)


## **📅 Better control over calendar conflicts**


When setting up study calendars, you now see clear options for preventing double-bookings: within the same study, across studies, or with external calendar events.


## ✨ ... and more quality of life improvements, like:


- Best-quality recordings automatically saved instead of livestream (rolling out gradually)
- New livestream controls with quality selection and helpful tooltips
- Improved livestream experience for guests with better messaging
- Opt-out URLs now visible and exportable in candidate table (with PII permissions)
- Clearer error messages when object (candidate / study / insight, etc.) is inaccessible


## **🤖** **Help shape the next AI release and try it first**


We're only getting started with AI capabilities, and your input plays a critical role in what we build. We're now working on one of the most requested features yet: Global Ask AI Search.


Are you excited? We are too, and we'd love for you to join and help make it the best one yet.


[Join the AI Beta waitlist →](https://greatquestion.co/features/ai-waitlist)


Research should never be a bottleneck. It should be accessible, fast, and built into every decision. That's the future we're building: one release, and one great question, at a time.


Keep asking great questions,


- The Great Question Team
